newsitem.title: USA: GAP JULY SAME-STORE SALES RISE 6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: GAP JULY SAME-STORE SALES RISE 6 PCT.

text.p: Gap Inc Thursday reported sales of $400 million for the four-week period ended Aug 2, 1997, up 24 percent over the year ago's $323 million. Same-store sales for July 1997 rose six percent compared with a seven percent increase in July 1996.
Sales of $2.576 billion for the 26 weeks ended Aug 2, 1997, represent an increase of 15 percent over sales of $2.233 billion for the comparable period in 1996.
The company's year-to-date comparable store sales were flat compared with a nine percent increase for the same period of 1996.
As of Aug 2, 1997, Gap Inc operated 1,984 stores compared with 1,756 at Aug 3, 1996, an increase of 13 percent.
